about.what_body: Óya tumar manual accessibility audit leká-assistant. Tumi sití gorle, sab gorle. Ektu ektu. Tumi zodi onek din dore ai kam gorso tahole zano aame kirom barer barer ekoi accessibility samassha-r shathe pori. Aami nizor puranó file o report-or moddhe khuja kore puranó accessibility audit-or karib-milá samassha bar korar shomoy bácháite chaiyesílam.
about.what_wcag: Ai data {wcag} porjonto extended (Level A o AA).
about.step_1_body: Liyini takayna — component nagar, elemento tipo, nozoray biboron.
about.step_2_body: Fattafatti result-or upor Priority Up/Priority Down arrow use kortê paron, result-or rank tune kortê. Star diyé age dekkao. Archive diyé lukao.
about.step_3_body: Tumar observation-er shathe shabse besi milá finding select korun. Result relevance onujayi rank kora hoise.
about.step_4_body: Ekta location prefix zog kortê paron (jemon "Global:") naile AI use kortê paron wording revise kortibarte.
about.feature_ai_body: Ekta short note diye jekono finding description refine koro. Tomar API key, tomar AI provider — kabú server-e store na.
about.feature_a11y_body: WCAG 2.2: focus, live regions, keyboard, reduced motion, high-contrast.

about.coming_custom: Tomar nijor custom finding add abur edit koro, cloud-e privately store kora.

about.what_body_2: Consistency onek dorkar, bisesh kore ai industry-te, aami nisít thakbár cháisilam impact, severity, description, o aksar milá technical remediation steps-e. Ai homebrew library-te WCAG-aligned finding write-up khujun, tumar observation-er shathe milá ekkán béche nun, customize korun ba specific kichu jogun, taarpor seedha tumar audit report-e copy/paste korun.
